controls: All tickers are proposals; exchange, corporate identity, listing and current tradability must be confirmed before canonical registration.
Research watchlist membership differs from canonical membership; never treat no entry here as absent in canonical repo.
Measure issuer AI-attributable revenue with quarterly reports and explicit allocation, not total reported revenue or inferred share.
Trace consumer capital origin -> OEM/gateway -> suppliers -> retained FCF; reconcile each flow to prevent double-counting.
Distinguish capacity, backlog, contract/prepayment and revenue; dated USD sources with original currency and FX for foreign issuers.
Record counterparty terms and exposure as hypothesis until sourced; map edges via B05 and events via B03.
Do not use current price, P/E, real-time availability, or investment ratings without timestamped sourced observations.
Score capital duration, passthrough share, customer concentrations, financial risk and substitute technologies before investable basket admission.
open_questions: Which missing candidates have financially material disclosed AI revenue?
What is the final-customer revenue pool size, bypass paths and percent captured by each intermediary?
Which capacity-constrained suppliers retain economics rather than competitors supplying substitution?
Do direct AI application revenues outweigh infrastructure financing and depreciation burden?

review.design: Rank research relevance, not stock expected returns
review.scoring_formula: Only after underlying fundamentals verified: economic_capture=(AI_attributable_revenue - pass_through_cost - incremental_operating_cost - annualized_capital_burden); unavailable inputs yield null rather than an estimate
priority_factors: Documented contractual or commercial link to demand
Market share of actual incremental spend at payer depth
Retained gross and operating economics rather than booked equipment passthrough
Capital required per dollar of durable incremental FCF
Ability of customer to substitute, internalize or self-design
Working capital, balance sheet and funding dependence
antifalsification: A memorandum or prepayment is not automatically recurring revenues
Issuer segment revenue is not wholly AI attributable
Potential bottleneck can disappear as production ramps or technology shifts
Two entities buying the same supplier is not automatically a relationship

methodology.flow_record: payer -> intermediary -> vendor -> tier-n vendor; attach recognized amount, accounting period, source and category; avoid summing linked gross flows as independent market sizes
methodology.capacity_record: facility, geography, process/technology, designed capacity, qualified capacity, installed capacity, energized capacity, utilized capacity, lead time, reserved customer, capex commitment, available_at
methodology.revenue_pool: bottom-up final-payer spend, procurement subset, intermediary gross revenue, retained value added and gross profit; distinguish stocks and flows
methodology.financial_record: USD reporting with original currency, source conversion rate and FX date
methodology.demand_record: separate addressable opportunity, budget authorized, signed contract, minimum commitment, deployed service and recognized revenue
methodology.investability: separate economic relevance from stock expected returns and valuation
